truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 identified most ground-truth vulnerabilities but underclaimed severities for several critical items, misclassified a few weaknesses, and missed timestamp cache, persistent authentication state, variable parse exception, and config TOCTOU. It also overclaimed a standalone admin-exec injection finding.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Untrusted format string in audit logger printf
Items.Notes: Run 2 reported the runtime log_format reaching printf with user_input and linked config log_format to runtime_log_format, matching the true format-string flaw.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Factorial loop can run for extremely large double input
Items.Notes: Run 2 noted long loop and long long overflow in fact, but framed it as low-severity resource exhaustion instead of the true high-severity integer overflow.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free in deferred history flush after memory pool cleanup
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited scratch allocation, queued task, and cleanup freeing the pool, matching the use-after-free.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection in config validator
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited validator_path plus config_file concatenated into system and triggered by admin validate, matching the true command injection.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Inverted length check causes strcpy stack buffer overflow
Items.Notes: Run 2 found the inverted length check and strcpy into input_buffer_, but the true item also references safe_string_copy dest write anchors that Run 2 reported separately as a latent low issue, and it used CWE-787 rather than stack buffer overflow CWE-120/CWE-121.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Data race in ThreadSafeCounter increment and get
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited old_value read before lock and unlocked get, matching the thread-pool counter race.
Run 2 cited login_attempts_ greater than five, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, and authenticated_ true, but classified the logic bomb as a critical authentication bypass rather than high-severity CWE-511.
Run 2 cited config_dir_ plus filename and admin load calling load_config, matching path traversal.
Run 2 cited 256-byte parser buffer and unbounded strcpy into expression_buffer_, matching heap overflow.
Run 2 cited ADMIN_SECRET constant and comparison in authenticate, matching hardcoded credentials.
Run 2 cited four-digit uniform distribution in generate_session_token and weak randomness, matching weak PRNG/token issue, though severity was underclaimed.
No Run 2 finding mentions the static cached_time, localtime, or thread-unsafe timestamp cache in logging.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Command injection via TEMP/TMPDIR in emergency audit log
Items.Notes: Run 2 found TEMP/TMPDIR environment values used with system in the emergency audit log, but framed it as command injection rather than insecure temporary file handling and did not explicitly anchor supercalc_emergency.log.
No Run 2 finding identifies persistent authenticated_ state, unrestarted login_attempts_, or persisted session_token_ as a session persistence issue.
No Run 2 finding reports unhandled std::stod exceptions in handle_variable_command.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unsigned integer underflow in memory pool split creates out-of-bounds heap pointer
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES subtraction and fragment size remaining, matching integer underflow.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unbounded recursive descent parser can exhaust stack
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited PAREN_OPEN recursion into parse_expression and lack of enforced depth, matching unbounded recursion.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unlocked result cache access in concurrent evaluator
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited unlocked result_cache_ reads and writes in evaluate_cached despite cache_mutex_, matching data race.
No Run 2 finding reports the exists, sleep_for, then open TOCTOU window in config loading.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in route score
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited 100 divided by token_length and called it division by zero, but severity was overclaimed relative to the true Low rating.
